tail risk propagating across multi-step agent workflows | TAS models safety-state transitions as an MDP and constrains tail risk under a shared budget vs eleven baselines on three benchmarks; an agent safety defence, and the Agent & Pipeline area excludes safety issues

unsafe reuse of semantically cached responses | SafeCache separates retrieval from safety approval, aggregates per-condition mismatches with a contradiction guard and calibrates routing under an unsafe-reuse target; safety-utility tradeoff in caching, excluded as safety

expected acceptance length in speculative decoding | D-REAL unbiased gradient estimator weighting positional overlap by prefix survival; DSpark/DFlash2 with Qwen3-8B across ten benchmarks, +0.23 tokens mean acceptance and up to 9.4% serving throughput; pure serving-speed optimization

residual knowledge recoverable after model editing | Memento learns a reusable prompt-space recovery signal (continuous prefixes or discrete prompts); 80.07% of held-out edited facts recovered over three LLMs and five editing techniques, +53.9% factual recall on pristine models; a knowledge-editing audit, not probing or representation-geometry analysis

memory cost of concurrent agentic RL environments | BunshinFork live whole-workspace container forking with tool-prefix caching and speculative tool execution; peak memory -43%, total memory -51%, rollout latency -23%; efficiency only, no listed failure

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits

decisions.anchor: corruption of model outputs caused by the numerics, kernels or serving stack underneath the model

cross-lingual knowledge-edit propagation gap treated as a structural bottleneck | closed-form decomposition into key-space propagation, parallel-residual and orthogonal-residual mismatch under ROME, MEMIT and AlphaEdit; the orthogonal residual dominates, and contrastive realignment improves key-space propagation while value-space mismatch remains

FPGA throughput for ternary BitNet inference | PENSA on an AMD Alveo U50 with HBM-packed TQ1_0 weights and interleaved scheduling, 58.09 tok/s at context 128 and 24.60 tok/s at 2048, 2.14-3.14x a Xeon E-2356G baseline; accelerator speedup with no reliability or precision claim

perplexity and accuracy loss at MXFP4 W4A4 quantization | layer-local block-Hadamard transform with Hessian-aware Flip-Refinement coordinate descent, 2.3% end-to-end overhead in vLLM on Qwen3-32B; lower perplexity than DuQuant++ and MR-GPTQ and matches their best on Llama-3-8B in 11x less quantization time

catastrophic forgetting across continual task streams | STABLE primal-dual optimizer enforcing an adaptive drift budget, with a bounded-drift/bounded-margin-erosion proof; long-horizon unimodal streams and CLIP multimodal streams match or beat specialized CL methods; forgetting mitigation, not pretraining-run instability or observability

unreliable public adapter checkpoints corrupting forgetting measurement | two-check provenance audit (base-model match, non-trivial delta norm) plus a leakage-free probing protocol on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Mistral-7B-Instruct; silent base-version mismatches and near-zero delta norms inflate measured interference by ~10pp, naive merging costs -10.5pp GSM8K and -18.3pp HumanEval

joint evolution of attention and token representations at fixed parameters | variational free-energy theory with Fisher-Rao attention flow, tracking bounds, coupled Hamiltonian dynamics and well-posedness proofs; pure theory with no interpretability, probing or failure evaluation

unlearning memorized or harmful content entangled with useful knowledge | HGU localizes unsupported spans, traces high-responsibility MLP neurons and gates them under a KL constraint; TOFU Avg 0.7221/0.7699 and WMDP forgetting vs retain/MMLU tradeoffs; unlearning efficacy, a model-side safety task rather than hidden-state analysis

whether recursive self-improvement can act on an unrepeatable frontier pretraining run | decomposed smaller loops over data pipelines, infrastructure and training of a 30B-A3B MoE on 11.8T tokens in three months; 801-30B-A3B-Base beats Qwen3-30B-A3B and Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B and trails only Qwen3.5-35B-A3B

recovery of weak directions under power-law signal decay | 'precision wall' analysis showing one constant sets the wall for Adam, grafted Shampoo and zeroth-order Adam on low-rank sensing, rotated quadratics and logistic regression; optimizer conditioning result, not floating-point or low-precision error

runtime planners that cannot evolve and miss millisecond control budgets | REINS harness grounding LLM output to a learned dynamics model, verifying with calibrated predicates and forward rollout, and consolidating into indexed rule memory; 98%+ compliance, nearly 50% collision reduction, 1.9-4.6 ms latency vs LLM-in-loop and offline-rule baselines, LLM invocation declining as memory matures

oracle-label cost in online RLHF | AERO routes contexts between oracle feedback and ensemble-based synthetic preference labels using vote entropy and adaptive thresholding; competitive alignment at reduced query budget vs online DPO and active-exploration baselines; sample efficiency with no RL training pathology

noise sensitivity and interpretability of activations in generic networks | ConwayNet fixed Game-of-Life lateral inhibition wired into FCN, CNN, wide-residual and GCN models, giving spatially coherent activation maps and 30x fewer disagreements under label noise; architecture design for non-LLM networks, not LLM internal representations

policy divergence and instability under repeated preference-data reuse | clipped importance ratio inside the DPO preference margin with KL trust-region bounds and a self-regulating adaptive baseline (P2O/PKTO); matches or exceeds DPO and KTO while maintaining better stability across multiple LLMs on three preference benchmarks

accepting harmful self-updates during recursive self-improvement | TRUST adapts online multiple-hypothesis testing to control the false-evolution rate, with a proven bound on unacceptable-loss updates; HotpotQA, DROP and APPS with DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Qwen-3.8-Flash, accepted-inferior ratio 45.59%->2.78% vs a greedy gate and SOTA statistical gates

20-35 s cold start per short agentic/RL GPU job | Firepool builds interchangeable warm pods, stages zero-VRAM standby pods in fractional GPU shares and caps warm pools with queue-driven budgets at LinkedIn; 94.7% of 3,206 peak-period requests served warm, 13x/10.8x faster agent/RL loops vs a fresh pod, p90 start 59.1 s->3.5 s

practical RL post-training failure modes | book walking the GRPO loop and five programs (math, search agents, training stability, MoE, software engineering), covering no useful reward, reward exploitation, stopped exploration and misleading evaluation; experiential lessons with no controlled baseline

training collapse under multi-pass rollout reuse | BRAT weights each token's gradient linearly down with its probability ratio to vanish at a trust-region boundary and bounds group-centered advantages; update alignment drops nearly an order of magnitude from in-sample to held-out rollouts across three base models, and BRAT avoids collapse with four reuse passes, higher average accuracy and lower seed variance

function-level HBM4 controller placement between host and base die | Ramulator 2 extension with HBM4 timing, maintenance and D2D link modelling; maintenance moves to the base die at no bandwidth cost, 61% host shoreline saved, 1.72x throughput of static partitioning; memory architecture study with no failure detection

how a small transformer represents the language of Coxeter group affine A2 | attention-pattern analysis of a trained transformer that motivated and then proved a word-theoretic conjecture about affine A2; mechanistic-interpretability case study, single model, no baseline

spurious-feature reliance in long chain-of-thought reasoning | counterfactual activation contrasts localizing MLP neurons and attention heads, then weight edits along token- and sequence-level directions (SWEET) from only 20 pairs; +11.8 points on perturbed and +2 points on original inputs across five open-weight reasoning models and five benchmarks, gap 17.6%->2.5%

semantically incorrect function calls despite valid syntax | DM-Call pairs schema validation with a separate decision model verifying function selection and arguments, feeding cumulative verification feedback; BFCL and API-Bank first-call gains over direct generation at modest cost; improves model-side call correctness rather than detecting a harness silently altering I/O

collective degradation under background network contention | LSTM + sequential-probability-ratio-test contention detector with a D3QN configuration selector over NCCL; -36% AllReduce latency vs NCCL and -32% vs converged AutoCCL on Chameleon Cloud, up to 65% speedup on A100/Slingshot-11 across six AI workloads

rounding noise injected when training low-bit codes directly on device | sensitivity-gated set-associative accumulator cache writing 8-bit sub-step updates back with unbiased stochastic rounding at 8.1 bits/weight; highest mean accuracy of nine deployed low-bit hand networks and of seven methods on twelve ImageNet-C corruptions, matching per-weight 8-bit accumulators with 56% of the state

fixed-size embeddings that cannot adapt to downstream resource constraints | HERL learns a hyperbolic (Lorentzian) adaptor for post-hoc dimension compression and expansion without retraining the encoder; image and text modality experiments show preserved downstream performance at lower cost; representation learning, not interpretability

cost and exactness of removing documents from a GraphRAG index | Lightfoot makes every node and edge a deterministic function of per-passage extractions, verifying graph identity after 10% deletion on MuSiQue, and compares index cost and retrieval against HippoRAG 2, LightRAG and fast-graphrag; retrieval-quality and cost system, no silent-alteration diagnosis

when to stop reasoning after an answer is stated | Prune-to-Probe suppresses late-MLP continuation coordinates and measures the stopping response against matched random interventions, leaving the cache untouched; MATH -2.60% reasoning forwards with all correct trajectories preserved, MMLU-Pro -1.145%; the probe captures decision stability, not correctness (AUROC 0.502)

error-risk budgeting across multi-stage LLM cascades | CompCRC decomposes accepted-error risk into additive stage contributions and certifies frozen budget allocations on held-out data; MMLU/GSM8K/HellaSwag, 1.33-2.00 points lower accepted-error risk and 30.37% lower cost than Global-CRC; statistical risk control, not detection of a pipeline silently altering I/O

decisions.reason: majority-vote test-time RL locking each question into an answer, often a wrong one | kernel law predicting the lock-in probability from start logits and a frozen kernel probe including parameter spillover; LoRA experiments with three models from two families forecast outcomes better than a logistic model refitted on the outcomes

decisions.anchor: agent harnesses, tool-call dispatch, RAG and orchestration pipelines

rounding-error drift over long reduced-precision integration | single-precision FESOM2 vs double-precision controls across 60-year hindcasts; a first implementation lost salt steadily and a 129 ZJ heat deficit, and 64-bit tendency accumulation plus carrying each update's rounding error removes the drift at most 8% extra runtime, 1.35-1.66x faster

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training
decisions.reason: when RL post-training cannot add a capability it is expected to amplify | two-axis state space (effective full-solution support, atomic primitive coverage) with three regimes tested on synthetic composition tasks across three small language models; checkpoints executing every primitive still fail to improve when solutions are never sampled, while modest composition supervision restores substantial RL gains

alignment decay from poisoned shared state across multi-agent sessions | ErosionBench executes 1,728 state-graph scenarios plus 198 image attacks and scores realized tool calls, showing perimeter defences over-refuse 54-92%; a safety/security benchmark, and the Agent & Pipeline area excludes safety issues

edge deployment of joint detection and region captioning | unified shared-encoder transformer with workload allocation across six edge nodes (four Jetson Orin, two Raspberry Pi 5); 38.1 FPS, 3.5 GB peak memory and 11.8 W on an Orin Nano, 35.2 FPS under four streams; embedded systems efficiency with no listed problem

NCCL AUTO cost-model mis-selection of collective algorithm-protocol pairs | NCCL-BOT warm-starts a per-context bandit from the model and learns from measured latencies; forced-arm H100 sweep cuts contexts losing more than 10% from 19 to 1 (p99 103%->9.9%), GB200 p99 60%->23%, but the authors report no net end-to-end win

unauthorized agent tool calls under indirect prompt injection | intent-graph audit with a deterministic per-call check (median 5.7 microseconds) and reasoning-guided escalation; a security defence, and the paper states that end-to-end validation remains open because the current agent showed no baseline attack success

decisions.anchor: corruption of model outputs caused by the numerics, kernels or serving stack underneath the model

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training
decisions.reason: tool-calling ability declining during agentic RL training | TACA traces negative tool credit to tool-token imbalance, aggregation amplification and failure-driven retries, then applies advantage projection, decision contrast and supervised replay; +4.61 points (Qwen2.5-1.5B) and +3.61 (Qwen2.5-3B) over MT-GRPO on six reasoning benchmarks

whether an agent's harness notes actually learn from its failure traces | matched-search control with a 9B frozen-weight model and teacher-written notes; +4.0 points on generated customer-service decisions over notes with the mistakes withheld, about 60% of the gain from search alone, no demonstrated gain in full conversations, and a blind audit judged 146 of 240 tool-use items defective

GPU and host memory capacity for long-context MoE training | OOM co-designs expert execution with state residency and activation retention, training 1M-token contexts and a 122B MoE on four H100s and 512K contexts on four 24 GB 4090s; 1.58-4.08x over CPU-offloaded FSDP2; pure systems efficiency

verification capacity consumed by low-yield branches in block-diffusion draft trees | D3Tree learns a per-candidate survival head and thresholded ancestor-closed subtree sizing; fastest in 70 of 72 load settings across six verifiers and 17 benchmarks, 3.2-4.0x over autoregressive at one request and 1.3-1.8x at 64 concurrent; speculative-decoding speed with no reliability angle

whether cross-lingual concept subspaces are shared, transferable or erasable | class-mean directions against random, permuted-label and covariance-matched nulls across six frozen encoders and 10,359 Bangla idiom senses; sharing holds in 10 of 12 tests, yet English-fitted LEACE erases under one point of Bangla figurative accuracy against 4-11 points for Bangla-fitted LEACE

opaque entangled Earth-observation embeddings | SAE decomposition with a tailored matched-sparsity, concept-alignment and spatial-scale protocol on AlphaEarth and Tessera; 88% of features align with at most one of 20 concept groups against a median of 12 per raw dimension, and trained SAEs leave eight times less variance unexplained than a frozen random dictionary

expert-parallel MoE decode waiting on the most loaded GPU under token-routing skew | Relief replaces the per-step linear program with a bidirectional pairwise relaxation in integer-halving passes; near per-step optimum at every group size, up to +37.3 points effective utilization over deployed static placement, 0.02% of a current accelerator's transistors

training-inference mismatch from quantized inference and asynchronous rollouts destabilizing post-training | all mismatch sources measured on one scale across three student-teacher pairs plus weight staleness and injected noise; on-policy distillation stays stable under rollout configurations that destabilize RL, an empirical mismatch budget appears, and FP8 recipes reach the same quality 1.62x sooner with at least 1.93x KV-cache tokens

KV-cache memory growth in agentic autoregressive video generation | SemanticKV scores cached entries by planner-constraint cross-attention groups and keeps top-k; four backbones on three benchmarks, VBench 84.10 vs 84.05 for the strongest compressed baseline and 83.99 for full KV, 3.35x memory reduction; quality-neutral compression for speed and memory

progressive model-harness incompatibility during alternating training | JoMoHa jointly trains an executable harness-generation policy and a task-execution policy with RL; ALFWorld, WebShop and DBBench, 70.3% average success and 97.0% on ALFWorld vs weight-only and harness-only baselines

security of prompt-injected LLM agents relative to a reference agent | PlanTERS mechanises relative security in a small agent language with runtime monitors and proves a fence theorem in Isabelle/HOL; formal security analysis with no evaluation of a silent pipeline failure

ultra-low-latency inference with lookup-table networks on FPGA | ConvLUT unrolls standard and depthwise convolutional LUT trees for MLPerf Tiny tasks; under ~50 ns latency, 8844x lower latency than non-logic-based prior implementations and +20 points accuracy over MLP-style LUT models on CIFAR-10; latency and accuracy only

whether harness additions exceed the native capability of the MLLM | SimplEvo writes a coordinate-free task memory once and refines a bounded working memory per training episode with no weight updates; EBench success 46.7%->81.7% with GPT-6-Astra, RoboDojo 69.63% SR, text-only memory matching frame-storing memories at fewer tokens

label budget still needed after a frozen representation looks useful | effective boundary complexity measured as boundary-near target mass, validated on 74 controlled maps (0.38% median relative error), CIFAR-100/Tiny-ImageNet backbone ranking (Spearman 0.872) and acquisition correlation 0.779-0.830; a label-efficiency diagnostic, not interpretability of internal structure

AdamW equilibria that are unstable and trajectories that do not converge | dynamical-systems analysis of AdamW's implicit fixed-point objective showing instability already in one dimension and persistent oscillation, plus sufficient local-stability conditions in higher dimensions and a convergent modification preserving the fixed points; theory only, no training-run evaluation

which representation should be probed inside a transformer | more than 144,000 linear probing evaluations across vision foundation models and LLMs showing layer and module must be chosen jointly; the best layer-module pair beats the best layer with the residual stream fixed, and fixed Act@100 / LN2@60 strategies recover 42% and 86% of the gains

agent wait time after each tool output in local CPU-GPU MoE serving | Ostinato keeps resident experts on GPUs in every forward pass with route splitting and per-GPU CUDA graphs; DeepSeek-V4-Flash on four RTX 4090D, median post-tool wait cut 22-55% and sessions finished 1.4-2.5x sooner than llama.cpp and KTransformers; serving efficiency

over-authorization of agent tool privileges through MCP | PRISM learns a counterfactual necessity model under sandbox interventions, induces roles via an information bottleneck and prunes with a bilevel Stackelberg game; 78.3% fewer authorized tools per role at 78.2% task success on AgentDojo, tau-bench and ToolEmu; security privilege reduction

training-infrastructure tuning blocked by OOM boundaries, compiler conflicts, measurement jitter and silent numerical drift | five-stage agentic harness (InfraRSI) with a fixed task contract against reward hacking, cluster-noise calibration, memory-cost pricing and a cross-hardware experience bank; four dense and MoE workloads up to 2.75x speedup, mean MFU 17.4%->30.0% vs existing tuners and coding agents

stale positive action credit in repeated-attempt frozen agents | EARN decays credit for repeatedly attained scores, raises credit for higher-scoring action segments and replays stored actions on context match; best final-four-episode score in 31 of 33 task-budget settings on Jericho, ScienceWorld and Crafter, bypassing 78.9-86.3% of candidate-generation calls

prompt-injection harm in tool-using agents | compares in-prompt defences with deterministic reference monitors, human approval and taint tracking on an effect-based oracle with 13 tasks and 12 tools; Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B attack episodes plus simulation, where human-approval and taint results are simulation-only; security, and partly hypothetical

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: the same tool error delivered differently changing agent recovery | placement, guidance, retained history and turn structure varied with pre-registered plans across 13 open models from 3B to 70B and deterministic reruns; a new user turn avoids the stopping failure seen when the exchange is removed, +14.2 points on ToolMaze with 7-8B models and +10.5 with 32-70B, no measurable gain on Loud/Quiet

LLM-written policy weights with no guarantee of intended behavior | weight-space programming combined with Storm PCTL model checking, optionally repairing weights on optimal actions; 18 runs over three environments all reach the optimal probability and a complex safety requirement holds in all six runs; formal verification of generated policies, no self-improvement loop or listed failure

budget-constrained multistep autonomous microscopy workflows | explicit scientific rewards, action costs, instrument observation models and pre-experiment knowledge transfer with a drift-and-recalibration campaign; real electron energy-loss spectroscopy data, simple acquisition rules remain strong baselines, and independent error analysis locates where model uncertainty is and is not a reliable learning signal

allocating test-time compute across sequential and parallel scaling strategies | ODSA gives an orchestrator LLM discovery, comparison and acceptance actions over stateless workers; +4.7 to 18.0 points on Humanity's Last Exam and +0.6 to 14.0 on LiveCodeBench across three models vs a single direct call; inference-time scaling with no listed problem

numerical instability of iterative proportional fitting for Schrodinger bridges | trust-region IPF constraining each update to a fixed KL divergence, interpreted as mirror descent with adaptive step size; improved stability on several sampling tasks; numerical-methods instability in a sampling algorithm, not precision or correctness of ML training/inference

decisions.anchor: the reliability and trustworthiness of long-running autonomous agent systems
decisions.reason: failure monitors degrading after deployment drift on long-running robots | Streaming Failure Forecasting keeps the offline monitor fixed and refits only its last linear layer from each episode's success label at 2.18 ms per policy call; better than the frozen monitor on 4 of 5 simulated suites under unannounced drift and for all four VLAs across 434 real SO-101 runs

closed-loop autonomous experimentation on physical hardware | testbed integrating commercial automation instruments with 24 cumulative hours of unattended operation, six campaigns of 48 iterations matching target absorbance spectra; the agentic optimizer needs up to 52% fewer iterations than Bayesian optimization and solves one target BO missed

which capabilities compression removes first and whether that order is predictable | seven perturbation and compression methods on eight instruction-tuned models and 16 tasks against preregistered predictions; failure order correlates 0.90 across four random perturbations and 0.875 for pruning vs quantization within a model, and fragility profiles predict held-out accuracy with median absolute error 0.11-0.12 vs 0.20-0.21 for uniform decline

how language selection and content commitment are ordered in multilingual generation | activation patching with content-matched controls plus SAE analysis across three LLMs; a consistent three-stage pattern (default English signal, then content, then target language), with the intermediate language signal only weakly sparse while a later sparse distinction resists intervention

sustained autonomous experimentation on physical instruments | coding-agent infrastructure runs synchrotron X-ray experiments on nanoparticle superlattices under evolving human objectives; three experiments with transcript audit reconstructing decision provenance, 61-67% interpretation/judgment messages and 59-68% multi-participant error corrections; no baseline comparison

token-level topic monitoring during generation with more than two or three classes | causal topic classifiers trained on SAE features extracted from prefill states and deployed at decode (TopicScope); Gemma-3 1B and 4B on seven synthetic topics, at most 5 macro-F1 points lost under perturbation, and SAE-free classifiers reaching baseline are several times larger

solution accuracy and physical consistency of weight-space programming for PDEs | Physics2Weight adds physics-constrained prompting and physics-guided architecture editing with iterative weight refinement; heat, advection, Burgers and Allen-Cahn equations beat conventional PINNs while still violating the governing equations for nonlinear PDEs; scientific-computing application

disembodied planners that sever physical grounding in self-driving laboratories | Embodied Science Agent pairs a memory/Bayesian Digital Agent with an instrument-controlling Embodied Agent over a unified interface; autonomous wastewater treatment across 200M conditions, 15 rounds, transmittance 82%->99.7% and 98.5% lower residual dye, visuomotor policies generalizing across instrument placements

whether a self-improvement gain survives the next self-update | 64 fresh runs x 3 candidates x 3 continuations on five 3-8B backbones with disjoint selection and scoring; immediate-selected utility is near zero and continuation lowers it by 1.78 points (95% interval [0.68, 2.88]), also negative for SmolLM3-3B and Llama-3.1-8B

what probe accuracy alone licenses about geometric structure | four-stage Bayesian pipeline separating decodability, shape, ownership and causal use on two-digit addition and multiplication in GPT-J 6B, Llama 3.1 8B and Pythia 6.9B; 19% of 1,330 shapes are owned against 81% inherited, and intervening on the shape retains about 61% of the full-probe effect
